scope: Native iPhone page zoom only; web viewport remains scalable
root_cause: WKWebView double-tap zoom ignores CSS manipulation/Capacitor zoomEnabled=false on affected iOS. Capacitor replaces userContentController after webViewConfiguration; inject viewport policy in webView(with:configuration:) instead.
fix: Native WKUserScript at document end sets minimum/maximum scale=1 and user-scalable=no; configuration respects viewport scale limits. Leaflet retains map gestures.
